Located along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the '''Doldur sector''' was in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Doldur [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], [[Monor II]], [[Geridard]], and [[Doldur]] itself. The [[Dragonflower Nebula/Legends|Dragonflower Nebula]] was also located in this sector: within the Nebula was [[Silver Station]].

During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Eisen Kerioth]]. It was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[Yuuzhan Vong War|their invasion of the galaxy]].
